spec.description: Air quality metrics from three Awair Element monitors (bedroom, lounge, study) via the Lifestyle Prometheus exporter.
1 when the device responded to the last poll within 3× the poll interval; 0 on timeout or error.
spec.title: Device status

spec.description: CO2 estimated from the TVOC sensor signal. Less accurate than the direct CO2 reading; useful when CO2 sensor is unavailable.
spec.title: Estimated CO2 (from TVOC sensor)

spec.description: PM10 estimated from the PM2.5 sensor. Coarse particles (2.5–10 µm); estimation accuracy is limited.
spec.title: Estimated PM10

spec.description: Internal CO2 baseline reference value from the TVOC sensor. Drifts over time as the sensor self-calibrates; stable value indicates a healthy sensor.
spec.title: CO2 baseline (TVOC sensor)

spec.description: Internal VOC baseline reference value from the TVOC sensor. Used for self-calibration; abrupt changes may indicate a sensor reset.
spec.title: VOC baseline

spec.description: Raw H2 signal from the TVOC sensor (SGP30). Used internally for VOC estimation; baseline shifts indicate sensor aging or environmental change.
spec.title: VOC H2 raw signal

spec.description: Raw ethanol signal from the TVOC sensor (SGP30). Used internally alongside H2 to estimate TVOC; large spikes correlate with cooking or cleaning products.
spec.title: VOC ethanol raw signal

spec.description: Per room, the hours in the last 24h that CO2 read above that room's own 6h-rolling baseline. Each tile is independent and bounded at 24h — do not sum across rooms: CO2 lingers after you leave, so several rooms read occupied at once and the total exceeds wall-clock time. Proxy for time spent in the room — blind to uninstrumented rooms, confounded by a second occupant.
spec.title: Room-hours occupied (last 24h)

spec.description: 1 when a room's CO2 sits >60 ppm above its own 6h-rolling minimum — i.e. likely occupied. Step plot per room.
spec.title: Presence (CO2 above room baseline)

spec.description: 1 (RISK) when relative humidity exceeds 60% — the mould-safety guardrail, independent of the comfort/Awair score.
spec.title: Mould risk — RH > 60%

spec.description: Composite air quality score (0–100). Higher is better. Awair's proprietary weighting of CO2, VOC, PM2.5, temperature, and humidity.
spec.title: Awair Score

spec.description: CO2 concentration in parts per million. >1000 ppm indicates poor ventilation; >1500 ppm is noticeably stuffy.
spec.title: CO2

spec.description: Total Volatile Organic Compounds in parts per billion. Elevated readings indicate off-gassing from materials, cleaning products, or cooking.
spec.title: TVOC

spec.description: Fine particulate matter (µg/m³). WHO guideline: annual mean <5 µg/m³; 24h mean <15 µg/m³.
spec.title: PM2.5

spec.description: Relative humidity (%). Comfort range is roughly 40–60%.
spec.title: Relative Humidity

spec.description: Dew point temperature (°C). A proxy for perceived humidity — above 16°C feels muggy; above 21°C is uncomfortable.
spec.title: Dew Point

spec.description: Absolute humidity in g/m³ — the actual water content of the air, independent of temperature.
spec.title: Absolute Humidity
